title: PHP 5.0.0's Zend engine in a physical Capstone domain under a hand-written SAPI and a stub libc, one image per corpus trigger (-DRUNG_E_CRASHnnn); the comparison column the virtual app port was retargeted from
workload: the corpus triggers compiled into the image through rung_E_domain.c, run by run-triggers.sh; FINDINGS.md holds the measurement in the order it was learned

note: Reads PHP's source from the same external /corpus mount as the app port. app/triggers is the trigger text lifted out of this port's #ifdef ladder (extract-triggers.py --check keeps the two equal).
